target.title: fix(whatsapp): keep LID ack reaction participants
target.body:
Closes #109979

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where WhatsApp group messages from LID-based sender identities could log a successful configured ack reaction while the reaction did not render in the WhatsApp group thread.

## Why This Change Was Made

WhatsApp group reaction keys need the original sender participant. The ack and status reaction paths now resolve one shared participant value from the inbound sender identity, preferring the phone JID when present and falling back to the LID when that is the only available sender key.

## User Impact

WhatsApp group ack reactions should appear consistently for LID-only group senders, and temporary ack cleanup uses the same participant key so reactions do not get stranded.

## Summary

- Add a shared WhatsApp auto-reply reaction participant resolver that falls back from `sender.jid` to `sender.lid`.
- Use the shared participant resolution in both ack reactions and status reactions.
- Add regression coverage for JID preference, LID fallback, missing sender identity, ack send/remove, and status set/clear paths.

## Change Type

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Chore

## Scope

- [ ] Gateway
- [ ] Skills
- [ ] Auth
- [ ] Memory
- [x] Integrations
- [ ] API
- [ ] UI/UX
- [ ] CI

## Evidence

- `bash -lc 'source ~/.config/nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 24.16.0 >/dev/null && node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/whatsapp/src/auto-reply/monitor/reaction-participant.test.ts extensions/whatsapp/src/auto-reply/monitor/ack-reaction.test.ts extensions/whatsapp/src/auto-reply/monitor/status-reaction.test.ts'` -> 3 files passed, 15 tests passed.
- `OPENCLAW_CHECK_CHANGED_REMOTE_CHILD=1 node scripts/check-changed.mjs -- extensions/whatsapp/src/auto-reply/monitor/reaction-participant.ts extensions/whatsapp/src/auto-reply/monitor/reaction-participant.test.ts extensions/whatsapp/src/auto-reply/monitor/ack-reaction.ts extensions/whatsapp/src/auto-reply/monitor/ack-reaction.test.ts extensions/whatsapp/src/auto-reply/monitor/status-reaction.ts extensions/whatsapp/src/auto-reply/monitor/status-reaction.test.ts` -> passed.
- `git diff --check` -> passed.
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check ...` -> passed.
- `node_modules/.bin/oxlint --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json ...` -> passed.

## Real behavior proof

**Behavior addressed:** WhatsApp group ack reactions for an inbound message whose sender has only a LID now pass that LID as the reaction participant for both send and cleanup.
**Environment tested:** Linux, Node v24.16.0, isolated temporary `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR`, local source checkout.
**Steps run after the patch:** Called the actual `maybeSendAckReaction` production function from source with a LID-only group sender and a registered WhatsApp runtime listener, then awaited the ack send and removal.
**Evidence after fix:**

```text
[whatsapp] Sending reaction "👀" -> message msg-1
[whatsapp] Sent reaction "👀" -> message msg-1
[whatsapp] Sending reaction "" -> message msg-1
[whatsapp] Sent reaction "" -> message msg-1
[
  {
    "chatJid": "120363000000000000@g.us",
    "messageId": "msg-1",
    "emoji": "👀",
    "fromMe": false,
    "participant": "277038292303944@lid"
  },
  {
    "chatJid": "120363000000000000@g.us",
    "messageId": "msg-1",
    "emoji": "",
    "fromMe": false,
    "participant": "277038292303944@lid"
  }
]
```

**Observed result:** The production ack reaction path sends the configured ack emoji with `participant: "277038292303944@lid"`, then clears the same message reaction with the same LID participant.
**Not tested:** Live WhatsApp group delivery with real linked WhatsApp credentials was not exercised in this environment.

## Root Cause

- Root cause: the WhatsApp auto-reply reaction options only included `sender.jid` as the group reaction participant.
- Missing guardrail: tests covered direct-chat reaction options but did not cover LID-only group sender identities for ack/status reaction paths.

## Regression Test Plan

- `extensions/whatsapp/src/auto-reply/monitor/reaction-participant.test.ts` covers JID preference, LID fallback, and missing identity.
- `extensions/whatsapp/src/auto-reply/monitor/ack-reaction.test.ts` covers LID-only group ack send and removal.
- `extensions/whatsapp/src/auto-reply/monitor/status-reaction.test.ts` covers LID-only group status set and clear.

## User-visible / Behavior Changes

Configured WhatsApp group ack reactions can render for senders whose inbound identity is LID-only instead of silently omitting the group participant key needed by WhatsApp.

## Security Impact

- New permissions? No
- Secrets handling changed? No
- New network calls? No
